text.markup: **Mentor**{br}At the start of your turn, if Sutcliffe is face-down in your arsenal, you may turn him face-up.{br}While Sutcliffe is face-up in arsenal, whenever you play a non-attack action card, deal 1 arcane damage to each hero and put a lesson counter on Sutcliffe for each damage dealt this way. Then if there are 3 or more lesson counters on Sutcliffe, banish him, search your deck for a **specialization** card, put it face-up into your arsenal, and shuffle.
